state_classes: NO_LOSS or exactly one lost site among q1..q8
shot_noise: Poisson; 100 detected signal-count equivalents per isolated occupied site, +1 background count per matched-filter channel

camera_failure.failure_detection: flag view failed when total matched-filter counts < 0.25*100*7

decoder.confidence: best-vs-second Poisson deviance gap >= 9, else AMBIGUOUS
decoder.policy: failed camera discarded; deterministic overlap never mapped directly to loss

sampling.class_balance: equal trials for all 9 physical states
